pages.title: Spiritual Power
pages.text: $(l)Spiritual power$() fuels techniques and many cultivation actions. Your maximum reserve rises with realm, stage, roots, physique, and other progression bonuses. The cultivation screen shows both the current amount and the server-calculated maximum.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: Restore spiritual power through compatible spirit stones, recovery pills, passive regeneration, meditation on a cushion, and aura-rich environments. A recovery pill is not consumed when it would have no effect. Active spirit-stone absorption is handled one stack at a time and stops when the stored power is exhausted.

pages.title: Cultivation Progress
pages.text: Meditation builds cultivation progress until the current stage cap. The realm sequence is: $(br)Qi Refining → Foundation Establishment → Core Formation → Nascent Soul → Deity Transformation → Void Refinement → Body Integration → Great Vehicle → Tribulation → True Immortal.

pages.title: Breakthroughs
pages.text: Use $(l)/seeking_immortals breakthrough$() after reaching the current stage cap. The server evaluates roots, physique, age and lifespan pressure, aura, injuries, qi-deviation risk, breakthrough aids, and realm-specific requirements. Failure loses part of the current-stage progress and may trigger qi deviation.

pages.title: Stages and Layers
pages.text: Qi Refining has thirteen layers. Foundation Establishment uses early, middle, late, and peak stages; later realms use their authored stage counts, while Tribulation has a single land stage. Each stage advances independently and can impose its own technique or method-layer gate.

pages.title: Age and Lifespan
pages.text: Age advances in server time and every realm has a lifespan limit. A successful major-realm advance raises the minimum lifespan to that realm's value. Longevity effects can add years, but they do not replace progression; reaching the limit is fatal unless another rule prevents it.

pages.title: Aura and Meditation
pages.text: Meditation yield depends on local aura, leyline conditions, dimension and region modifiers, a valid meditation cushion, formations, roots, physique, methods, and temporary boosts. Movement, hunger, nearby hostile creatures, or being attacked can interrupt meditation.

pages.title: Viewing Your State
pages.text: Open the inventory and select the $(l)Cultivation$() button for realm, roots, combat attributes, study progress, and meditation yield factors. Commands $(l)/seeking_immortals lingli$(), $(l)realm$(), and $(l)root$() provide compact server-authoritative summaries.
